Class Pages2kClimateProvider

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.data.Pages2kClimateProvider
public final class Pages2kClimateProvider extends Object
PAGES 2k Consortium (Nature Geoscience 2019 / Paleoceanography 2017) Paleoclimate Provider.

Provides programmatic access to the 2,000-year multi-proxy Common Era surface temperature reconstruction and the 647 geographically distributed paleoclimate proxy archive sites (tree rings, ice cores, speleothems, lake and marine sediments, corals, and boreholes).

Physical equations and historical baseline reference:

  • Global Mean Surface Temperature (GMST) anomalies are expressed in degrees Celsius (\(^\circ\text{C}\)) relative to the 1961–1990 CE instrumental climatological normal: $$\Delta T(t) = T(t) - \overline{T}_{1961-1990}$$
  • Ensemble statistics include the median (\(q_{0.50}\)), the 2.5th percentile (\(q_{0.025}\)), and the 97.5th percentile (\(q_{0.975}\)) across 7,000 reconstructions spanning diverse methods (BHM, CPS, M08, OIE, PAIR, CCA).
  • Spatial geodesic distance between simulation cells and proxy sites uses the Haversine metric: $$d = 2 R_{\oplus} \arcsin \left( \sqrt{\sin^2\left(\frac{\Delta \phi}{2}\right) + \cos \phi_1 \cos \phi_2 \sin^2\left(\frac{\Delta \lambda}{2}\right)} \right)$$ where \(R_{\oplus} \approx 6371.0\,\text{km}\).
